newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Davids ponders extended Asia option.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Davids ponders extended Asia option.

text.p: Grocery retailer and wholesaler Davids Ltd has been offered an extended option on the purchase of an Asian food business, chairman John David said on Tuesday.
Davids currently has no Asian operations but has an option to acquire the Southeast Asian activities operated by the David family, which owns 41.5 percent of Davids.
David told a media briefing the David family had offered the public company the opportunity to extend that option.
"It is may understanding that the independent directors who are meeting on the subject will probably...accept that offer," he said.
David said the family had made the offer as Davids was still engaged in the rationalisation of recent takeovers.
"We the family are quite patient and are quite prepared to allow that option to be extended," he said.
The length of any extension would be decided by the independent directors.
David said Asian business was progressing well, but was not yet profitable.
Davids earlier said net profit fell to A$24.15 miillion in the six months to December 31 from A$29.24 million in the previous corresponding half.
